c1.copy:
Thanks for connecting, {{module.standard.first_name}}.

When the people inside a business rate {{module.custom.theme}} below their peers, it rarely stays an HR problem. It turns up in turnover, agency bills and how long roles sit empty.

We help leadership teams fix the story at the root. For DHU Healthcare that added over £2m to the bottom line in 20 months, and we're happy to stand behind a programme that pays for itself within two years.

Would a one-page snapshot of how {{module.standard.company_name}} comes across to staff and candidates, next to your peers, be useful?

c2.copy: Hi {{module.standard.first_name}}, I've been reading what staff and candidates say about {{module.custom.sector_peers}} this year. Some useful patterns for people teams. Would be good to connect.
c2.doc_text: Hi {first_name}, I've been reading what staff and candidates say about {sector_peers} this year. Some useful patterns for people teams. Would be good to connect.

c2.copy:
Thanks for connecting, {{module.standard.first_name}}.

At {{module.standard.company_name}}, what people say online keeps coming back to {{module.custom.theme}}. Candidates read the same pages before they apply, so expectations get set before day one.

We help close the gap between what people are promised and what they find. At MAN Truck & Bus UK attrition went from 20% to under 10% within a year, and we'd put a quarter off your unwanted turnover in writing.

Would a one-page snapshot, by theme and next to your peers, be useful?

c3.copy: Hi {{module.standard.first_name}}, I've been looking at what candidates read about {{module.custom.sector_peers}} before they apply. Some useful patterns for talent teams. Would be good to connect.
c3.doc_text: Hi {first_name}, I've been looking at what candidates read about {sector_peers} before they apply. Some useful patterns for talent teams. Would be good to connect.

c3.copy:
Thanks for connecting, {{module.standard.first_name}}.

Before someone applies to {{module.standard.company_name}}, they read what staff say online, and right now that keeps coming back to {{module.custom.theme}}. When the story puts good people off, roles go to agencies.

MAN Truck & Bus UK were spending over £600k a year on agencies. Within a year it was under £30k, because the right people started applying direct. We'd put half off your agency spend in writing.

Would a one-page snapshot of what candidates see about {{module.standard.company_name}}, next to your peers, be useful?
